import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int SRC = MAXN - 2;
    static final int DST = MAXN - 1;

    static class FlowNet {
        int[] to = new int[MAXM];
        int[] f = new int[MAXM];
        int[] c = new int[MAXM];
        int ecnt = 0;

        List<Integer>[] g = new List[MAXN];
        boolean[] vis = new boolean[MAXN];

        FlowNet() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
            to[ecnt] = v;
            f[ecnt] = 0;
            c[ecnt] = cap;
            g[u].add(ecnt++);
            
            to[ecnt] = u;
            f[ecnt] = 0;
            c[ecnt] = 0;
            g[v].add(ecnt++);
        }

        boolean dfs(int v, int sink, int amt) {
            if (v == sink) return true;
            vis[v] = true;

            for (int idx : g[v]) {
                if (!vis[to[idx]] && c[idx] - f[idx] >= amt &&
                    dfs(to[idx], sink, amt)) {
                    f[idx] += amt;
                    f[idx ^ 1] -= amt;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int solve(int src, int sink) {
            int amt = 1 << 30;
            int res = 0;

            while (amt > 0) {
                if (dfs(src, sink, amt)) {
                    res += amt;
                } else {
                    amt >>= 1;
                }
                Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static FlowNet net = new FlowNet();
    static int N, T;
    static char[][] G1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] G2 = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] d = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] mark = new boolean[15][15];

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < N &&
               0 <= y && y < N &&
               G1[x][y] != 'Y' &&
               G1[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsZ(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        d[sx][sy] = 0;
        qx.add(sx);
        qy.add(sy);

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            assert !qy.isEmpty();
            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[k];
                int ny = cy + dy[k];
                if (ok(nx, ny) && d[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    d[nx][ny] = d[cx][cy] + 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfsS(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> ql = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(mark[sx], false);
        mark[sx][sy] = true;
        qx.add(sx);
        qy.add(sy);
        ql.add(0);

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            assert !qy.isEmpty();
            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();
            int lv = ql.poll();

            if (Character.isDigit(G2[cx][cy]) && G2[cx][cy] != '0') {
                net.connect(sx * N + sy, N * N + 1 + cx * N + cy, INF);
            }

            if (lv >= T) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[k];
                int ny = cy + dy[k];

                if (ok(nx, ny) && !mark[nx][ny]) {
                    if (d[nx][ny] > lv + 1) {
                        qx.add(nx);
                        qy.add(ny);
                        ql.add(lv + 1);
                    } else if (d[nx][ny] > lv && Character.isDigit(G2[nx][ny]) && G2[nx][ny] != '0') {
                        net.connect(sx * N + sy, N * N + 1 + nx * N + ny, INF);
                    }
                    mark[nx][ny] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void setup() {
        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N && sx == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N && sx == -1; j++) {
                if (G1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsZ(sx, sy);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(G1[i][j]) && G1[i][j] != '0') {
                    net.connect(SRC, i * N + j, G1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(G2[i][j]) && G2[i][j] != '0') {
                    net.connect(i * N + j + N * N + 1, DST, G2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(G1[i][j]) && G1[i][j] != '0') {
                    bfsS(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
            N = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
            T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
            
            br.readLine(); // skip empty line
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                G1[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
            }
            
            br.readLine(); // skip empty line
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                G2[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
            }

            setup();
            System.out.println(net.solve(SRC, DST));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
